name: Gmina Kościerzyna (Poland)
description: Horizontal tricolour of yellow, dark blue and green in the ratio 3:1:2; the yellow stands for the sands, the blue for the lakes and rivers and the green for the forests.
history: Polish gmina flags are established by resolution of the gmina council under the Act on Badges and Uniforms, normally after an opinion of the Heraldic Commission; the flag takes the colours of the arms.
